source: MarCom, Landis & Gyr E650 with RS485 DLMS-Modbus Gateway, rev. 3.107 EN

sources.title: Landis & Gyr E650 with RS485 DLMS-MODBUS Gateway (MarCom)
sources.note: Modbus mapping area; up to four meters on one gateway, one map per meter

description: E650 energy meters (up to four) behind a MarCom RS485 DLMS to Modbus gateway
notes: The Modbus data comes from a DLMS to Modbus gateway made by MarCom that reads the E650 meters over RS485; the meter itself does not speak Modbus. Up to four meters connect to one gateway; each has its own block of registers (meter 1 starts at 40016, meter 2 at 40216, meter 3 at 40416, meter 4 at 40616) and the gateway-wide registers 40000 to 40014 are shared.

The manual writes the addresses as 4x40000 to 4x40798 (holding registers); they are used here as they are with address_base 0. If reads come out one register off, the gateway counts from 1 and address_base should be 1.
Each value takes 2 registers (FLOAT, DINT or UDINT). The word order is not stated; big is assumed. A value the meter does not answer reads -1.

The meter's serial number must be written to the gateway (registers 40004, 40006, 40008, 40010 for meters 1 to 4, or on its web page) before the first reading. The gateway's default address is 192.168.0.122; Modbus RTU on its RS232 ports and Modbus TCP on its Ethernet port.

Energy and power registers carry the DLMS OBIS code in their description (for example 1.8.0 is total active energy A+, 1.6.1 maximum power in time slot 1). The 'previous month' values are the OBIS codes with an asterisk. Units are not given by the manual.
